label: The list itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the draw-commands list it is called on.
details: The game documents nothing more, and no game text or GUI file uses it on this type. Other types have a function with the same name that hands the object over as a parameter.

label: The viewer itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the draw-commands viewer it is called on, for use as a parameter.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type. It belongs to the internal tools of the game's interface.

label: Capture frame
summary: Going by its name, makes the draw-commands viewer capture one frame of the interface.
details: An action that returns nothing, part of the game's internal interface tools. The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Clear capture
summary: Going by its name, throws away the frame the draw-commands viewer captured.
details: An action that returns nothing, part of the game's internal interface tools. The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Show fewer draws
summary: Going by its name, lowers the number of captured draw commands the viewer shows by one.
details: An action that returns nothing, part of the game's internal interface tools. The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Draw offset down
summary: Going by its name, moves the viewer's starting position in the captured draw commands back by one.
details: An action that returns nothing, part of the game's internal interface tools. The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Captured draw count
summary: Going by its name, returns how many draw commands the viewer shows from the captured frame, as a whole number.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Captured draw offset
summary: Going by its name, returns the number of the draw command where the viewer's list starts, as a whole number.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Captured frame number
summary: Going by its name, returns the number of the frame the viewer captured, as a whole number.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Draw command data
summary: Going by its name, returns the data of the captured draw commands.
details: The game does not name the type it returns and no game file uses it.

label: Show more draws
summary: Going by its name, raises the number of captured draw commands the viewer shows by one.
details: An action that returns nothing, part of the game's internal interface tools. The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Draw offset up
summary: Going by its name, moves the viewer's starting position in the captured draw commands forward by one.
details: An action that returns nothing, part of the game's internal interface tools. The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: The viewer itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the draw-commands viewer it is called on.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type. Elsewhere the game uses a function of this name to hand an object over as a parameter, for example the trait name call with a character.

label: Set draw count
summary: Going by its name, sets how many captured draw commands the viewer shows.
details: An action that returns nothing, part of the game's internal interface tools. The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Set draw offset
summary: Going by its name, sets the position in the captured draw commands where the viewer starts its list.
details: An action that returns nothing, part of the game's internal interface tools. The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: The duchy group itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the duchy group it is called on, for use as a parameter.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type. The realm window uses this type to reach one duchy and its list of counties.

label: Counties of the group
summary: The list of counties in this duchy group.
details: Vanilla uses it as the item list of a list widget in the realm window (my realm), so the window can show one row per county.

label: Duchy of the group
summary: The duchy title this duchy group stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it in the realm window as the data source of a row and to print the duchy's name (without a tooltip, with the first letter capitalised).

label: The duchy group itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the duchy group it is called on.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type. Elsewhere a function of this name hands an object over as a parameter.

label: The candidate itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the mandate candidate it is called on, for use as a parameter.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type. The type belongs to the dynastic cycle window, where a character is a candidate for the mandate.

label: Candidate character
summary: The character who is this candidate in the dynastic cycle window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a part of that window, so the character's portrait, name and so on can be shown.

label: Legitimacy bar
summary: The bar (a progress bar object) that shows this candidate's legitimacy.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a bar in the dynastic cycle window.

label: Legitimacy level progress
summary: A number showing how far this candidate has come towards the next legitimacy level.
details: Vanilla feeds it into the value of a progress bar in the dynastic cycle window.

label: The candidate itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the mandate candidate it is called on.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type.

label: The dynasty itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the dynasty it is called on, for use as a parameter.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type.

label: Player can customize
summary: Whether the player is allowed to customize this dynasty.
details: Vanilla uses it to decide whether a part of the dynasty and house window is visible.

label: Can unlock perk
summary: Going by its name, whether the dynasty can unlock a dynasty perk that is relevant now.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Custom text
summary: Going by its name, returns a custom text built for the dynasty, chosen by the name given in the brackets.
details: The game's other types have a function of the same name that takes the name of a custom localization, for example for a character. No game file uses it on a dynasty.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the custom text to use.

label: Living members
summary: The list of living characters in this dynasty.
details: Vanilla uses it as the item list of the ledger window.

label: Dynasty name
summary: The name of the dynasty as text, without the word 'Dynasty'.
details: Vanilla uses it in memory texts such as 'adopted into the ... Dynasty', where the word is added around it. Going by the sibling function, this version carries a tooltip when shown and the NoTooltip version does not.

label: Dynasty name, no tooltip
summary: The name of the dynasty as plain text, without the tooltip the normal version adds.
details: Vanilla uses it in the dynasty view texts, for example 'Dynasty' after the name in titles and descriptions.

label: Dynasty culture
summary: The culture of the dynasty.
details: Vanilla uses it to read the coat-of-arms mask, offset and scale that the culture defines for dynasty coats of arms.

label: Dead members
summary: The list of dead characters of this dynasty.
details: Vanilla uses it to count them in the dynasty view's 'Dead Members' heading.

label: Dynast
summary: The dynast, the character who currently leads the dynasty.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the dynast's name, to check that there is one, and to describe a dynasty perk's effect for that character.

label: Dynasty coat of arms
summary: The coat of arms of the dynasty.
details: Vanilla asks it for a picture or a slot of a given size in pixels, for example 56 by 56 or 88 by 88.

label: Houses of the dynasty
summary: The list of houses that belong to this dynasty.
details: Vanilla counts it in the ledger tooltip heading, and also uses it in the succession event window text.

label: Prestige level icon
summary: The picture that stands for the dynasty's current prestige level.
details: Vanilla uses it as the texture of an icon in the ledger window.

label: Founded houses
summary: The number of houses of the dynasty that have been founded, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it in the dynasty view, and picks 'House' or 'Houses' depending on whether it equals one.

label: Head of dynasty
summary: The character who is head of the dynasty.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source in the dynasty and house window, the legacy window and the ledger (where it goes on to the head's house).

label: Dynasty ID
summary: The dynasty's internal ID number.
details: Vanilla passes it to the actions that open the dynasty window or the dynasty legacy window for this dynasty when its coat of arms is clicked.

label: Members
summary: The list of members of this dynasty.
details: Vanilla only checks whether the list has any items: the ledger row is shown dimmed when it is empty.

label: Members text
summary: Going by its name, returns a text about the dynasty's members.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Dynasty name
summary: The dynasty's name as text, with a tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in many texts, for example 'You are not a member of the ... dynasty' and the tooltip about living members.

label: Dynasty name, no tooltip
summary: The dynasty's name as plain text, without a tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in the dynasty view's button tooltips and in a ledger text.

label: Next perk cost
summary: The amount of dynasty prestige needed for the dynasty's next perk, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as the cost of the next legacy and in the progress tooltip next to the dynasty's current prestige.

label: Next perk progress
summary: A number showing how far the dynasty has come towards its next perk.
details: Vanilla converts it with a helper into the value of a progress bar in the legacy window.

label: Next prestige level name
summary: The name of the dynasty's next prestige level.
details: Vanilla uses it in the house view in the line 'Next prestige level: ...'.

label: Number of counties
summary: Going by its name, the number of counties tied to the dynasty, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the ledger. The game does not say whose counties are counted.

label: Number of dead members
summary: How many dead members the dynasty has, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the ledger window.

label: Number of legacies
summary: How many legacies (the game's texts also call them dynasty perks) the dynasty has, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the ledger, and draws that row dimmed when the number is zero.

label: Number of living members
summary: How many living members the dynasty has, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it in the dynasty view: 'N Living Members' and the list heading.

label: Number of members
summary: How many members the dynasty has, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it in the ledger tooltip, where it is labelled as living members, and in the succession event window.

label: Number of rulers
summary: How many rulers the dynasty has, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the ledger window.

label: Dynasty prestige
summary: The dynasty's prestige (renown), as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the dynasty view and the progress tooltip, next to the cost of the next perk.

label: Prestige breakdown
summary: Going by its name, a text that breaks the dynasty's prestige down into its parts.
details: Vanilla places it in the dynasty prestige tooltip, between the heading and the progress line, and shows it with a plus sign.

label: Prestige frame
summary: The frame number that picks which picture of the dynasty's coat-of-arms frame is shown.
details: Vanilla uses it as the frame of the coat-of-arms frame image, for a dynasty and (through its dynasty) for a house. Going by its name, the frame follows the prestige level. That the value is a frame number is read from its use as a frame.

label: Prestige income
summary: How much dynasty prestige the dynasty gains per month, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it with a plus sign followed by '/month' in the house view and the ledger.

label: Prestige level
summary: The dynasty's prestige level as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it in the ledger tooltip, which also prints the level's name.

label: Prestige level effect
summary: Going by its name, returns the effect the dynasty's prestige level gives.
details: The game does not name the type it returns and no game file uses it.

label: Prestige level name
summary: The name of the dynasty's current prestige level.
details: Vanilla uses it in the dynasty view and house window, and in the succession event window.

label: Prestige level progress
summary: A number showing how far the dynasty has come towards its next prestige level.
details: Vanilla feeds it into the value of a progress bar in the house, dynasty tree and ledger windows.

label: Prestige progress tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the dynasty's progress towards its next prestige level.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of the progress bar in the house and dynasty tree windows.

label: Next level text
summary: Going by its name, returns a text about the dynasty's next prestige level.
details: The game does not name the type it returns and no game file uses it.

label: Prestige progress text
summary: A text describing the dynasty's progress in prestige.
details: Vanilla places it as the last line of the dynasty prestige tooltip, after the breakdown.

label: Power to replace dynast
summary: Going by its name, the amount of power another house head needs to replace the dynast.
details: No game text uses it on a dynasty. A similar text about a dynast being replaced when someone exceeds a power amount exists in the dynasty view, but it is cut off here, so the link is a hint only. It returns a number with decimals.

label: Total military strength
summary: The combined military strength of the dynasty, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in a ledger column.

label: Has dynast
summary: Going by its name, whether the dynasty currently has a dynast.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it. Vanilla checks the dynast's validity instead.

label: Has perk
summary: Whether the dynasty has unlocked the dynasty perk given.
details: Vanilla passes the perk of the current row of the legacy window and uses the opposite to show perks not yet unlocked.

label: Is my dynasty
summary: Whether the dynasty is the one the given character belongs to.
details: Vanilla passes the player's character, so it means 'is this the player's own dynasty'. It is used to show a part of a tooltip.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, vanilla gives the player

label: Is valid
summary: Whether this dynasty exists, so there is something to show.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a notification part only when a dynasty is set.

label: Make scope
summary: Going by its name, turns the dynasty into a script scope, so script values can be asked of it.
details: No game text uses it on a dynasty. The game calls it on the player in texts that ask a script value of the player's scope; that is a hint only.

label: The dynasty itself
summary: The dynasty itself, used to pass it as a parameter to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the action that opens the dynasty customization window and to the ledger functions that pin a dynasty or check that it is pinned.

label: The window itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the dynasty customization window it is called on, for use as a parameter.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type.

label: Can click Finish
summary: Whether the Finish button of the dynasty customization window can be used.
details: Vanilla uses it as the enabled state of that button. The matching text function explains why it is not.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the dynasty customization window.
details: An action that returns nothing. Vanilla runs it when the close button is clicked.

label: Why not finish
summary: The text that tells whether and why the Finish button can be used.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of the Finish button.

label: Coat of arms designer
summary: The coat of arms designer that the window uses to edit the dynasty's arms.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of the designer part of the window.

label: Dynasty being edited
summary: The dynasty the window is customizing.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data source in the window, also to reach the dynast.

label: Dynasty name text
summary: The text of the dynasty name as it is currently typed in the window.
details: Vanilla shows it in the name text field of the window. That it is the typed value is read from the matching edit action.

label: Selected culture
summary: Going by its name, the culture currently selected in the dynasty customization window.
details: No game file uses it on this type. The game uses a function of this name on the coat of arms designer as a data source, which is a hint only.

label: Finish
summary: The action of the Finish button of the dynasty customization window.
details: An action that returns nothing. Vanilla runs it when the Finish button is clicked. What it applies is not documented.

label: Name text edited
summary: The action that runs when the dynasty name field is edited.
details: Returns nothing. Vanilla runs it on the text-edited event of the name field.

label: The window itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the dynasty customization window it is called on.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type.

label: The house itself
summary: Going by its name, gives back the house it is called on, for use as a parameter.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it on this type.

label: Current military strength
summary: The house's military strength right now, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the confederation window.

label: Maximum military strength
summary: Going by its name, the largest military strength the house could reach, as a whole number.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it. Its sibling for the current strength is used in the confederation window.

label: Player can customize
summary: Whether the player is allowed to customize this house.
details: Vanilla uses it to decide whether a part of the dynasty and house window is visible.

label: Custom text
summary: Going by its name, returns a custom text built for the house, chosen by the name given in the brackets.
details: No game file uses it on a house. Other types have a function of the same name that takes the name of a custom localization, for example for a character.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the custom text to use.

label: Living members
summary: The list of living characters in this house.
details: Vanilla uses it as the item list of the ledger window.

label: House name
summary: The name of the house as text, without the word 'House'.
details: Vanilla uses it in effect texts such as 'became the ... house head' and 'house ... aspiration changes'. It carries a tooltip; the NoTooltip version does not.

label: House name, no tooltip
summary: The name of the house as plain text, without the tooltip the normal version adds.
details: Vanilla puts it after the word 'House' in titles of the house view and the government administration window.

label: House changelog
summary: Going by its use elsewhere, the list of recorded changes in the house's history.
details: No game file names it on this type. The dynasty and house window uses a function of this name on its house to fill a list (the first 13 entries) and to show a different part when the list is empty; that is a hint only.

label: Claimed artifacts
summary: Going by its name, the list of artifacts the house has claimed.
details: The game does not name the type of the items and no game file uses it.

label: Confederation
summary: The confederation this house belongs to.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a part of the dynasty and house window.

label: House culture
summary: The culture of the house.
details: Vanilla uses its template data for drawing the house's coat of arms.

label: Unity stage
summary: The house's current unity stage (the level of how united the house is).
details: Vanilla reads its name and icon in the ledger and uses it as the data source in the succession law window.

label: Dead members
summary: The list of dead characters of this house.
details: Vanilla uses it to count them in the ledger.

label: Dynasty of the house
summary: The dynasty this house belongs to.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data source and reads the dynasty's name and prestige level name through it.

label: Family status
summary: Going by its name, a text naming the house's family status.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the government administration window. The game documents nothing more.

label: Year founded
summary: The year the house was founded, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it in texts such as 'Founded in ... AD'.

label: Founder
summary: The character who founded the house.
details: Vanilla prints the founder's name in the house view and uses the founder as a data source of the house window.

label: House government
summary: Going by its name, the government of the house.
details: No game file uses it on a house. The game's texts do use a separate function of this name that takes a government by its key, which is a different thing.

label: Head of house
summary: The character who is the head of the house.
details: Vanilla prints the head's name in the house view and the government administration window.

label: Head or last head
summary: The head of the house, or the last known head if there is none now.
details: Vanilla takes the ID of this character to open the dynasty tree of that character. The fallback is read from the name.

label: Heir of house
summary: The character who is the heir of the house.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a part of the house window that is shown only when the house has an heir.

label: House aspiration
summary: The aspiration the house has chosen.
details: Vanilla reads its name in confederation and family attribute tooltips.

label: Aspiration bonus tooltip
summary: The text that describes the bonus of the house's aspiration.
details: Vanilla shows it as the text of a tooltip part.

label: Aspiration cooldown days
summary: Going by its name, the number of days left before the house may change its aspiration again.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Aspiration word
summary: The word the game uses for the house's aspiration (its flavour name), with a tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in warnings such as 'You cannot change ... for another ...' in the family attribute window.

label: Aspiration word, no tooltip
summary: The same aspiration word, as plain text without a tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in titles and buttons such as 'Change ...' in the family attribute window.

label: Aspiration level index
summary: The position (as a whole number) of the aspiration level the house has reached.
details: Vanilla passes it to the aspiration's level-name function and compares it with the row position in a list of levels to decide which rows to show.

label: House coat of arms
summary: The coat of arms of the house.
details: Vanilla asks it for a picture or a slot of a given size in pixels, for example 56 by 56.

label: Land share in realm
summary: A text with the share of the realm's land the house controls.
details: Vanilla shows it after the county control icon in the government administration window.

label: Land share, short
summary: A shorter text with the number of counties of the realm that the house controls.
details: Vanilla uses it in a tooltip that begins 'Counties controlled:'.

label: House power
summary: The house's power rating, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it as the value of the family rating in the government administration window.

label: House power name
summary: The name of the house's power category.
details: Vanilla uses it as the heading of the house bonus tooltip.

label: Relation with house
summary: The relation between this house and another house.
details: Vanilla passes the player's house and reads the level's name from the result, or uses it as a data source.

label: House title
summary: The title that belongs to the house.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a part of the dynasty and house window.

label: House unity
summary: The house's unity value, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the house window and the succession law window.

label: House ID
summary: The house's internal ID number.
details: Vanilla passes it to the default action for a click on the house's coat of arms.

label: Members
summary: The list of members of this house.
details: Vanilla only checks whether the list has items: the ledger row is shown dimmed when it is empty.

label: House motto
summary: The house's motto, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it in the house view in quotation marks and in the ledger.

label: House name
summary: The house's name as text, with a tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in relation, confederation and ranking texts.

label: House name, no tooltip
summary: The house's name as plain text, without a tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in confederation lists, the family rank tooltip and the house relation history.

label: Number of counties
summary: Going by its name, the number of counties tied to the house, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in a ledger column, and dims the row when the number is zero. The game does not say whose counties are counted.

label: Number of dead members
summary: Going by its name, how many dead members the house has, as a whole number.
details: No game file uses it on a house. The ledger uses the same-named function on a dynasty, which is a hint only.

label: Number of members
summary: How many living members the house has, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it in texts labelled 'Living Members'.

label: Number of rulers
summary: How many rulers the house has, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the ledger and dims the row when it is zero.

label: Total military strength
summary: The combined military strength of the house, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in a ledger column.

label: Has been founded
summary: Whether the house has been founded.
details: Vanilla uses it to decide whether a part of the dynasty and house window is visible.

label: Has head of house
summary: Whether the house has a head.
details: Vanilla uses it to show parts of the confederation window and of the house window only when there is a head.

label: Has heir of house
summary: Whether the house has an heir.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the heir part of the house window.

label: Has aspiration cooldown
summary: Going by its name, whether the house must still wait before changing its aspiration.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Has relation with house
summary: Whether this house has a relation with the house given.
details: Vanilla passes the player's house, to show a relation part of a coat-of-arms tooltip only when one exists.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a house, vanilla gives the player's house

label: Has house title
summary: Whether the house has a house title.
details: Vanilla combines it with the setting that enables the AI watch windows, to show a part of the house window.

label: Has house unity
summary: Whether the house has house unity.
details: Vanilla uses it to show unity parts of the ledger, the succession law window and a tooltip only when it does.

label: Is bloc leading house
summary: Going by its name, whether the house leads its bloc (a group of houses such as a confederation).
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it. Vanilla uses the confederation-specific check instead.

label: Is dominant
summary: Whether the house is a dominant house.
details: Vanilla uses it with the powerful and imperial checks to choose which part of the house window is shown, and in the family tooltip heading.

label: Is founding house
summary: Whether the house is the founding house of its dynasty.
details: Vanilla uses it and its opposite to switch parts of the house window. That it means the founding house of the dynasty is read from the name.

label: Aspiration inactive
summary: Whether the house's attribute (aspiration) is inactive.
details: Vanilla uses it to pick a warning text instead of the normal tooltip, and to show a warning in the government administration window.

label: Is imperial
summary: Whether the house is an imperial house.
details: Vanilla uses it with the powerful and dominant checks to choose which part of the house window is shown, and in the government administration window.

label: Is in unity stage
summary: Going by its name, whether the house is in the given house unity stage.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The unity stage to check, going by the name.

label: Leads confederation
summary: Whether the house is the leading house of its confederation.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a part of the confederation window.

label: Is noble family
summary: Going by its name, whether the house counts as a noble family.
details: The game documents nothing more and no game file uses it.

label: Player is member
summary: Whether the player belongs to this house.
details: Vanilla uses it to choose between the texts 'your house' and 'not your house', and to show parts of the house window. The game does not name its return type, but vanilla uses it as a yes or no.

label: Is powerful
summary: Whether the house is a powerful house.
details: Vanilla uses it with the dominant and imperial checks to choose which part of the house window is shown, and in the family tooltip heading.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether this house exists, so there is something to show.
details: Vanilla uses it and its opposite to show or hide house parts in the HUD and in notifications.

label: House as scope
summary: The house as a script scope, so script values can be asked of it.
details: Vanilla uses it to ask a script value of a house (`MakeScope.ScriptValue('...')`) in the realm window's list of confederation member houses.

label: The house itself
summary: The house itself, used to pass it as a parameter to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the confederation's cohesion per house calculation and to the military strength tooltip of the confederation window.

label: Uses aspirations
summary: Whether the house uses house aspirations.
details: Vanilla uses it to show map icons and parts of the house window; in the house window it is combined with a check on the domicile.
